sentences.en: It was the greatest joy that I have ever experienced.
sentences.zh: 这是我所经历过的最大的快乐。

sentences.en: Jane experienced many things in a year. So did I.
sentences.zh: 简一年中经历了许多事情。我也一样。

sentences.en: I experienced intense cold at the South Pole last year.
sentences.zh: 去年我在南极体验到了强烈的寒冷。

senses.zh: 经历，遭遇；体会到，感受到（experience 的过去式和过去分词形式）
